cohort: The study participants were women undergoing elective caesarean section, with mean age of 25.5+/-3.6 years in group A and 24.6+/-3.4 years in group B.
finding: Single dose antibiotic prophylaxis was found to be as effective as conventional multi dose antibiotic therapy, while also being cost-effective, preventing antibiotic resistance, and reducing patient side effects and nursing staff workload.
mod_finding: The primary finding on the efficacy of antibiotic prophylaxis is specifically relevant to women undergoing elective caesarean section.
